name: Design and Implement Multi-Tenant Billing Subscriptions
task_description: Architect and deliver an end-to-end multi-tenant subscription billing engine from customer opportunity framing to production release readiness.

guardrails.enforce_5_whys_discovery: Peel away superficial requirements to uncover root business model and tenant boundaries
guardrails.design_deep_modules: Design simple, narrow billing interfaces concealing complex prorating and state machines
guardrails.prohibit_unrecorded_assumptions: Explicitly record architectural assumptions and tenant isolation constraints
guardrails.enforce_compound_learning_loop: Synthesize cross-stage lessons and publish architectural retrospective into repository memory

invariants: Architecture, explicit assumptions, and OpenAPI contract must precede implementation
One authoritative feature spec and task list maintained across all lifecycle phases
All verification backed by executable command output and rigorous pre-release checklists
Capture multi-tenant edge cases and systemic rules in completion report Section 5
